authority.reason: Every available outcome through the frozen panel end was already visible to the project before this search. No historical interval is a sealed holdout.

objective.training_target_formula: 2 * rank(method='average', pct=True) - 1, grouped independently by training date
objective.training_target_semantics: This historical formula is percentile-scaled but is not exactly zero-centered for a finite daily cross-section: its minimum is 2/n - 1 and its daily mean is 1/n when there are no ties. It is retained unchanged to preserve the evaluated specification.
objective.preprocessing_weight_semantics: SimpleImputer medians and StandardScaler means/variances are fitted with ordinary row weighting. Date-equal sample weights are applied only to the Ridge loss. This evaluated behavior is retained unchanged; date-weighted preprocessing is a separately registered forward comparison candidate.
objective.portfolio: two fixed 50 percent sleeves; an unfilled slot remains cash
objective.primary_metric: scheduled-day top2 arithmetic mean after 20 bp round-trip cost
objective.display_policy: always rank two when point-in-time source coverage permits
objective.trade_policy: shadow only; no automatic order is authorized

frozen_input.folds: calendar-month walk-forward with training strictly before each scoring month

traceability.commit_scope: The four byte-exact stage registrations and the compact canonical candidate history are committed. Exploratory runners, full intermediate result JSON files, and large intermediate picks remain uncommitted; their original SHA-256 values above preserve identity.

zero_base_screen.selection: none; all seventeen outcomes are retained
zero_base_screen.discovery: daily_rank_ridge was the only candidate with positive net20, positive top5-removed net20 and nonnegative net40

rank_target_sensitivity.role: alpha, window, bounded-target and ensemble sensitivity; it cannot promote production
rank_target_sensitivity.locked_target: within-training-date average percentile of observed open-to-close return mapped to [-1,1]

liquidity_hypotheses.overlap_disclosure: no_trade_rate_20, no_trade_rate_60, flat_oc_rate_20 and zero_range_rate_20 exactly overlap the earlier v0.6 G5 raw columns. Their combination with a cross-sectional rank target is new; the raw sources are not.
liquidity_hypotheses.threshold_policy: candidate screens used only a quantile recomputed from dates strictly before each scoring fold
liquidity_hypotheses.known_limit: the archive has no usable volume, turnover, spread or trading-unit history; share price is not accepted as a size or liquidity proxy

required_audits: best, worst and selected-loss case export

mean_return.target: daily cross-sectional open-close return percentile mapped to [-1,1]

robustness.target: daily cross-sectional open-close return percentile mapped to [-1,1]
robustness.features: base_features plus no_trade_rate_20, no_trade_rate_60, flat_oc_rate_20 and zero_range_rate_20

fixed_shadow_specifications.interpretation_constraint: The fitted G5 coefficients are mostly positive. L6 must not be described as a learned liquidity penalty; it is only a retrospective robustness role with lower code concentration.

stop_rule.reason: The remaining variants cannot be distinguished without reusing the same outcomes again. The binding uncertainty is absent executable-liquidity and exact 08:58 forward data.
restart_requires: new point-in-time sessions not used in this search
turnover, trading unit, indicative spread or observed execution cost
exact 08:58 futures, indicative-open, board or PTS snapshots
content-addressed feature and model specification before outcomes
